arguments.command:
export FIX_CSV=$(ls /opt/nothingness/media/*.opus | sort | paste -sd, -); export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; DRIVE=.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py; echo "fixtures: $FIX_CSV"; $DRIVE screen void >/tmp/drive_out1.json; $DRIVE call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths="$FIX_CSV" startIndex=0 | tee /tmp/drive_setqueue.json; $DRIVE pause | tee /tmp/drive_pause.json; $DRIVE settings open | tee /tmp/drive_settings_open.json; $DRIVE tap void-settings-status-shuffle | tee /tmp/drive_shuffle_tap.json; $DRIVE settings close | tee /tmp/drive_settings_close.json; $DRIVE resume | tee /tmp/drive_resume.json; $DRIVE call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState | tee /tmp/drive_state_before_next.json; SONG1=$(jq -r '.songInfo.path' /tmp/drive_state_before_next.json); SHUF1=$(jq -r '.shuffle' /tmp/drive_state_before_next.json); echo "before next: $SONG1 shuffle=$SHUF1"; $DRIVE next | tee /tmp/drive_next.json; $DRIVE call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState | tee /tmp/drive_state_after_next.json; SONG2=$(jq -r '.songInfo.path' /tmp/drive_state_after_next.json); SHUF2=$(jq -r '.shuffle' /tmp/drive_state_after_next.json); echo "after next: $SONG2 shuffle=$SHUF2"; python3 - <<'PY'
import os
fix_csv=os.environ['FIX_CSV']
paths=set([p.strip() for p in fix_csv.split(',')])
import json
s1=json.load(open('/tmp/drive_state_before_next.json'))
s2=json.load(open('/tmp/drive_state_after_next.json'))
path1=s1['songInfo']['path']; path2=s2['songInfo']['path']
assert s1['shuffle'] is True, 'shuffle not enabled before next'
assert path1 in paths and path2 in paths, 'paths outside fixture set'
assert path1!=path2, 'track did not transition'
print('OK: one transition within fixture set')
PY
